author: render-agent
note: ungraded per-product layers (RGBA, straight alpha) and shadows (grey RGB, multiply); grade_cut_r5.py grades and cuts them

curtains.what: a* and b* only toward the card's cream (designer section 3), one hue rotation and one chroma factor for every pixel; the armchair post's light line (QA section 4) closed in the same cut

method.recolour: Lab of the ungraded layer: (a, b) -> k R(dh) (a, b), L* unchanged; dh, k iterated on the graded set-B r4 scene
method.post_line: where 0.02 < fa < 0.98 and the curtain is behind: the curtain's own colour from its clear pixels beside the edge (normalised blur, sigma 2), plus (F_core - F) x fa / ((1 - fa) a), F_core the furniture's opaque core next to the edge (normalised blur, sigma 2); clipped to 0-1
method.masks: QA p2_colour.py: alpha 255 eroded 5x5, rows 100-1400 (306080 px); plaster ring 15-40 px

curtains.note: measured on the graded set-B scene recomposed with the change (the r4 stack); grade_cut_r5.py re-measures on the r5 scene

magazine-holder.what: the two thin strap rods to the SKU photo's satin silver (designer section 4); the glossy black tubes unchanged (documented exception, pending WM-M1)

target.source: the Orange SKU photo, 66 columns across the free rod spans (scratchpad)

magazine-holder.profile: L*(t) = (52 - 16 t + 26 exp(-((t + 0.35) / 0.30)^2)) x gain x the render's own light along the rod (normalised, ^0.5, 0.85-1.12); t = signed distance across the rod / half width (negative = up)
magazine-holder.note: QA measures the target on the r5 scene (the photo: L* median 56, C* 2.5)
